LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Scenario.EnergyM:
As a mechanoid, you do not need to eat and rest every day like organic beings, but you still need regular charging to keep your body running.

Build power generation facilities and rechargers early to ensure a stable energy supply and avoid being forced into dormancy by depleted energy.

If you want mechanoid mechanitors to recharge on a regular schedule like organic beings, assign sleep hours in the "Schedule" menu. During scheduled sleep hours, mechanoid mechanitors will prioritize trying to recharge.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Scenario.Bandwid: Although mechanoid mechanitors generally cannot gain bandwidth by wearing equipment, other methods available to human mechanitors still apply, such as bandwidth-providing buildings and mechanitor implants.\nMechanoid mechanitors can also increase their bandwidth by using mechanoid commander chips.
